preamble: Change of the voiceless velar stop [k] to the bilabial [p]. With plain /k/ it is rare; the clearest case is Romanian, where Latin /k/ became /p/ before /t/ and in /ks/ (octo > opt, coxa > coapsă, lactem > lapte). The better-known labiovelar developments (PIE *kʷ > Greek and P-Celtic p, Latin aqua > Romanian apă) start from [kʷ], not plain [k], and are not filed here.

examples.note: /ks/ > [ps] in some environments; compare Dalmatian copsa.
Aromanian lapti shows the same change.
